Ava: Quick micro-game — describe your desk snack using exactly three emojis. I'll start: 🥨☕️😴

Ravi: 🍎🧀💻

Lena: 🍪🤫😇

Tom: 🥛🍫🌀

Priya: 🥒🌶️🙃 (if you squint it's a salad emo-phase)

snackbot: :trophy: Snack MVP goes to Ravi for the sensible apple-cheese-laptop combo.

Ava: 😂 love that award. also: who's buying bagels tomorrow? quick poll: yes/no

Lena: yes please! :bagel: :raised_hands:

Tom: no — bringing croissants instead :croissant:

Ravi: depends if coffee is included ☕️

Priya: +1 croissants & coffee = eternal peace :pray:

Ava: ok, croissants it is. I'll put a sticky on the kitchen whiteboard. /remind #general tomorrow 9am "croissants?" (bot not actually set)

snackbot: :calendar: Reminder queued (jk)

Lena: also new rule: if you take the last croissant, you must bring jam next time. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Tom: agreed. jam deal. :thumbsup:

Ava: thread closed. one-liners and emojis for the win. :sparkles:
